newsitem.title: USA: Briggs & Stratton sees lower Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Briggs & Stratton sees lower Q4 earnings.

text.p: Briggs & Stratton Corp said Wednesday that earnings for the fiscal 1997 fourth quarter and full year will be down from a year earlier because of a fourth quarter charge for the cost of an early retirement window.
The company earned $0.91 per share in the fiscal 1996 fourth quarter and $3.19 for the full year.
Briggs also said it was setting a "dutch-auction" self-tender for up to 5.875 million shares of its common stock.
The tender offer price is expected to range from $43 to $51 cash per share, subject to market and other customary conditions, the company said.
The offer is expected to start April 22 and will expire May 20 unless extended.
The company currently has 28,927,000 shares of common stock outstanding.
The company said it intends to enter into a new credit facility with Bank of America as agent, to finance the tender offer and its seasonal working capital needs.
It said it intends to reduce borrowings under this credit facility pursuant to a planned $175 million offering of debt securities, announced separately today.
